seed_data_creation: Tests create and cleanup TEST_ prefixed integrators
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 78 - Bug fixes verified: 1) POST /api/integrators/import now returns HTTP 200 with ImportResult containing detailed 'errors' array even for validation errors. Each error has: row, column, value, error_type (missing/invalid/format/duplicate), message, and suggested_action. 2) DELETE /api/integrators/{id} actually deletes integrators now (before fix it was dead code that never executed the delete). 3) Frontend ImportResultPanel correctly renders the errors table inside the import wizard dialog with columns: Fila, Columna, Valor, Error, Acción sugerida. 4) GET /api/integrators/import/template returns valid .xlsx template. 5) Import validation includes: empty name, invalid type, invalid modality, invalid date format, non-existent gestor. All pass and show detailed errors.
